topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't find it. It was right here, where I left it, where it always was. Now the space is empty, wrong. I've searched everywhere—the streets, around the corner, back and forth. My hands shake as I check the same spots again, hoping it will somehow reappear. It’s like a piece of me is missing, a silent absence screaming at the edge of my vision. I keep walking, circling, the world narrowing down to this one impossible fact. Where did it go? What should I do? The driveway taunts me, its emptiness a cold, unyielding answer.
